instruction: Navigate to the help section about refunds and returns.

metadata.explanation: Task requires navigating to refund/return information on Ticketek website. Similar to original task but targets different help content. Uses is_expected_url_pattern_match metric to verify URL contains refund/return/exchange keywords. No new functions needed - uses existing Chrome getters and metrics.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator logic can correctly verify the navigation task by checking URL patterns
Getter (active_tab_info) correctly extracts the active tab URL via accessibility tree + Playwright
Metric (is_expected_url_pattern_match) correctly searches for refund/return/exchange keywords in URL
Expected value semantically matches the task requirement - checking for refund/return/exchange in URL is appropriate
Complete coverage - the evaluator verifies that navigation to help section occurred by checking URL content
Runtime feasibility - getter can access active tab state, no special postconfig needed
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider making regex pattern case-insensitive (e.g., '(?i)refund|return|exchange') to handle URLs with different casing like 'Refund' or 'RETURN'
Pattern 'refund|return|exchange' is appropriate for Ticketek help URLs, but could optionally include additional keywords like 'policy', 'warranty' if Ticketek uses those terms
